thread:
Maya: quick design review pls — roles matrix keyboard flow + deep-linking into audit logs. attaching a proto screenshot: https://figma.com/s/proto-roles-nav :eyes:
Ashley: looked. main concern: when you open an invite from the matrix, keyboard focus jumps to modal, but on close it doesn't restore to the previously focused row. screen-reader users lose context.
Ron: yep, current impl calls `modal.focus()` but doesn't remember the origin. easy fix: store `document.activeElement` before open and restore on close. however we have to be careful with virtual focus on mac VoiceOver.
Ashley: also recommending ARIA: add `aria-modal=true`, use `role="dialog"` and announce the row that was inviting (e.g., "Inviting user to role: Billing Admin"). small copy tweak: change "Invite sent" toast to "Invitation sent — returns to role matrix" for SR clarity.
Sam: from usability sessions — folks expect a deep-link back to the exact audit event that shows the invite. can we enrich audit log URLs with `?actor=invite&user_id=...&event=invite_sent` so PMs and support can jump straight to the entry?
Ron: adding structured query params is fine. backend needs to accept stable event ids though. Audit index currently uses cursor-based pagination; deep-link should translate event id -> cursor. I can add an endpoint `GET /audit/locate?event_id=...` that returns a cursor.
Devon: quick UI copy debate: on SSO toggle we currently show "Enforce SSO for invites". Suggest more explicit: "Require SSO for organization invites" or even shorter "Require SSO to join org". which reads better with the tooltip?
Maya: prefer "Require SSO to join org" (short, action-oriented). tooltip can expand: "When enabled, users must sign in via your org SSO to accept invites."
Ashley: keyboard nav for the roles grid — propose roving tabindex pattern. arrow keys move between cells, Enter opens the invite modal, Space toggles multi-select. Also add `aria-describedby` linking to a hidden region that explains keyboard shortcuts.
Ron: engineering note: roving tabindex plus the table semantics will need careful handling for screen readers; might be easier to use a list/grid with `role=grid` rather than native table to control focus. I'll prototype both.
Sam: accessibility nit: the audit-log deep-link landing should autofocus the event row and set `aria-live="polite"` with a short announcement like "Audit event selected" so SR users know the change. Avoid `aria-live=assertive`.
Maya: love that. Can we also add a compact context menu on the role row (three dots) with keyboard-accessible actions: View audit, Invite user, Export?
Devon: for Invite microcopy in the modal, let's remove jargon. Instead of "delegate admin" use "Limited admin (no billing access)" — testable with customers.
AuditBot: created temp endpoint ticket #AUD-492 to support event->cursor translation. :white_check_mark:
Ashley: one more a11y micro-ux: when SSO is required, the toggle should have `aria-checked` and the state should be reflected in the row's `aria-label` (e.g., "Billing Admin — SSO required").
Maya: thanks all — action items: Ron to prototype grid+roving tabindex (due EOW), Ron to sketch audit locate endpoint with POC, Ashley to update aria/copy snippets in figma, Sam to add two test scenarios for SR users, Devon to write 2 copy variants. I'll follow up with a short usability session next Tue. :calendar:
Ron: noted. starting on prototype now.
Sam: happy to run the SR checks once the prototype lands.
Devon: will draft copy and ping Maya. :thumbsup:
